visurf.core: Label augmentation and smoothing match paper equations 6-7
differences: Reference KL retained despite paper removing it
Compact JSON preference alignment not established

rl_zvp.core: Three advantage branches and response-relative entropy match equation 5 under the current single-update schedule
limits: Frozen entropy semantics require rechecking before multiple policy updates

papo.core: Released low_var_kl sign, clamps and sampled-surprisal signs match
differences: Both sides recomputed with gradients, corresponding to an optional author mode rather than its default
Fixed-count merged-grid masking instead of independent Bernoulli masking on original 14-pixel patches

cfpo.core: Paper-inspired intervention variant; not equivalent to released author baseline
differences: Paper and author log-ratio directions conflict
Vector prior versus author scalar broadcast prior
Per-head population statistics versus pooled valid-weight sample statistics
Prompt-only versus all post-image query positions
Joint current gradients versus cached no-grad corrupted teacher
Different entropy coefficients and gamma

active_o3.core: Trainable observer and frozen task module preserve the main structure
differences: Crop proposals themselves evaluated as evidence boxes rather than task-model localized boxes
Binary answer and project-specific heuristics
Training code unavailable

axpo.core: Trigger, fork boundary and masks match the paper; candidate ranking and unselected advantages do not
differences: Per-patient extra-rollout cap instead of global breadth-first budget
Equal averaging of valid original and continuation losses
Single crop step and fixed binary reader
Training code unavailable

defacto.core: Three views, counterfactual abstention/guess penalty and selection-reward branches preserve the main mechanisms
differences: Complete positive GT replaces automated evidence proposals
JSON and strict binary/unknown answer replace reasoning and semantic judge
No sequential region exploration
Different abstention, guessing, format and selection coefficients
